title: GA/9/2011 of STATE OF UTTARAKHAND Vs MAHESH RAM

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Government Appeal No. 09 of 2011

State of Uttarakhand ....Appellant
Versus
Mahesh Ram ....Respondent
Mr. D.K. Sharma, Sr. Addl. A.G. assisted by Mr. N.S. Kanyal, Brief Holder for the State.
Mr. Devesh Upreti, Advocate for the respondent.
Judgment Reserved- 17.07.2017
Date of Judgment - 28.07.2017
Coram: Hon'ble Rajiv Sharma, J
 Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J
Per: Hon'ble Rajiv Sharma, J
 State has come in an appeal against the
judgment dated 11.08.2010, rendered by learned Sessions
Judge, Champawat in Sessions Trial No.23 of 2009,
whereby the respondent, who was charged with and tried
for the offences under Section 363, 342, 323, 376 of IPC
read with Section 511of IPC, has been acquitted.
2. The case of the prosecution, in a nutshell, is that
a report was lodged by Laxman Ram to the effect that on
07.10.2009 he had gone to sleep. He got up at 3:00 AM on
08.10.2009. His daughter aged about 09 years was not on
the bed. She was missing. He searched for her in the
house. The girl could not be traced. One rickshaw puller
namely Rajendra Kumar brought his daughter to his house
at 06:00 AM. His daughter told him that she was forcibly
taken away by the accused Mahesh Ram at 2:30 AM. She
got up. She cried. The accused left her at Hanumangarhi.
Thereafter, she came back to her house. Thereafter, the FIR
was registered and the investigation was commenced. The
prosecutrix was examined by the doctor. The case property
was taken into possession. The prosecution has examined
as many as eleven witnesses in support of its case. The
statement of accused was also recorded under Section 313

2
of Cr.P.C. He denied the case of the prosecution. The
respondent was acquitted, as noticed hereinabove. Hence,
this appeal.
3. Learned counsel for the State has vehemently
argued that the prosecution has proved its case beyond
reasonable doubt. Learned counsel on behalf of the
accused-respondent has supported the judgment dated
11.08.2010.
4. We have heard learned counsel for both the
parties and perused the judgment and record carefully.
5. PW1 Laxman Ram has deposed that his
daughter was sleeping with him. He got up at 3:00 AM. His
daughter was missing. He searched for her. On 08.10.2009,
one rickshaw puller namely Rajendra Kumar brought his
daughter to the house. His daughter told him that the
accused Mahesh Ram has forcibly taken her away while
she was sleeping. She was beaten up and sexually
assaulted. Thereafter, the accused ran away. The Pradhan
told him that the matter could be compromised. However,
the accused did not come till 10.10.2009. Thereafter, he
went to the police station and lodged the report at
Tanakpur. In his cross-examination, he has admitted that
he has gone to the police station and his wife was with him.
Nobody else accompanied him. He has admitted that when
he gone to sleep, they had closed the door. The latch was
not broken. He has also deposed that in case, the accused
had met him he would not have lodged the report.
6. PW2 is the prosecutrix. She has deposed that
she was sleeping between her parents. The accused carried
her. She got up on the way. He has taken her upto
Hanumangarhi. The accused has sexually assaulted her.
She was wearing skirt at that time. He put his private part
in her vagina. The accused after doing bad act ran away.

3
She met a rickshaw puller. She came with him to her
house. In her cross-examination, she has admitted that
there was no bleeding from her private part. She was not
wearing any underwear at the time of incident. Her parents
were sleeping with her. The door was closed but there was
no latch on the door. When they went to lodge the report,
the accused was in the police station.
7. PW3 Kalawati is the mother of the prosecutrix.
Her husband got up at 3:00 AM. He searched for the girl.
She had gone missing. One rickshaw puller has brought
her daughter to her house. In her cross-examination, she
has deposed that 10-12 people had gone to the police
station to lodge the report. She saw private parts of her
daughter. There was lot of blood. The clothes of her
daughter were soaked with blood. She was wearing skirt
and underwear.
8. PW5 Dr. Prabha Joshi has medically examined
the prosecutrix. According to her, there was a possibility of
sexual assault.
9. PW10 Jeet Singh is the material witness. He has
deposed that father of the prosecutrix came to him at
08.10.2009. He told him that the accused has forcibly
taken away his daughter at 2:30 AM. The accused left his
daughter at Hanumangarhi. Thereafter, she was brought
back by one rickshaw puller. She was beaten up by the
accused and he attempted to sexually assault her. In his
cross-examination, he has admitted that PW1 Laxman Ram
has only told him about the beatings administered to his
daughter by the accused and not about sexual assault on
her.
10. PW11 S.I. Hem Chand Pandey has visited the
spot and recorded the statements of PW1 Laxman Ram and
the prosecutrix.

4
11. According to the contents of FIR, exhibit Ka-1,
the complainant Laxman Ram got up at 3:00 AM on
08.10.2009. His daughter aged about 09 years was sleeping
with him. She was not on the bed. He switched on the light.
He searched for her. At 6:00 AM, she was brought by one
rickshaw puller namely Rajendra. He made inquiries from
the prosecutrix. The prosecturix told him that the accused
has taken her away in a sleep at 2:30 AM. She got up near
Hanumangarhi and cried. She was beaten up by the
accused. Thereafter, the accused left her at Hanumangarhi.
The girl reached the home. The date of incident was
08.10.2009, but the FIR was registered after 60 hours of
the incident.
12. PW1 Laxman Ram has also deposed that in case,
the accused had met him, he would have not lodged the
report. In the FIR, it is not mentioned that the prosecutrix
was sexually assaulted. However, PW1 Laxman Ram, in his
statement, has stated that his daughter has told him that
the accused has beaten her and sexually assaulted her.
13. The case of the prosecution is that the accused
has taken away the prosecutrix forcibly while she was
sleeping in her house. PW1 Laxman Ram has deposed that
the door was locked. He has also deposed that latch was
not broken. It is thus, very difficult to believe that the
accused has taken away the prosecutrix from the custody
of the parents while they were asleep. The accused could
not take her away when the door was closed and latched.
PW1 Laxman Ram has deposed that he has gone to the
police station along with his wife. However, PW3 Kalawati
has deposed that 10-12 people have gone to the police
station to lodge the FIR. The prosecutrix has deposed that
there was no bleeding in her private parts. However, PW3
Kalawati has deposed that she has seen the private parts of
her daughter. There was lot of bleeding. All the clothes of

5
her daughter were soaked with blood. The prosecutrix has
deposed that she was not wearing any underwear on the
date of incident. However, PW3 Kalawati has deposed that
her daughter was wearing underwear. PW3 Kalawati has
deposed that the accused has come to their house and told
that he was not involved. PW1 Laxman Ram has
categorically deposed that the accused has not come to his
house and if he had come, he would not have lodged the
report.
14. PW10 Jeet Singh has deposed that PW1 Laxman
Ram has come to him and told that his daughter was
forcibly taken away and beaten up by the accused and he
tried to sexually assault her. However, in his cross-examination, he has categorically deposed that PW1
Laxman Ram has not told him that the accused has
attempted or committed any sexual assault on her.
According to PW10 Jeet Singh, PW1 Laxman Ram has only
told him that his daughter was beaten up by the accused.
In his cross-examination, PW10 Jeet Singh has further
deposed that Hanumangarhi area was thickly populated
area and prosecutrix has not told the name of the accused
in his presence. According to the prosecution, Rajendra
Kumar has brought the prosecutrix from the market.
However, though, he was material witness but not
examined by the prosecution. There is no explanation by
the prosecution why Rajendra Kumar was not examined.
15. The prosecutrix in her examination-in-chief has
deposed that the accused was taken her away and she
recognized the respondent Mahesh Ram. However, PW3
Kalawati has deposed that the accused has come to their
house next day at 9:00 PM and claimed that he was not
involved in the crime. Thereafter, they woke her up and she
recognized the accused. Then, they came to know that it

6
was the accused and none else. Thereafter, the accused
was taken to police station and he was sent to lockup.
16. The case of the prosecution throughout is that
the name of the accused was known to the parents in the
morning of 08.10.2009, but it has come in the statement of
PW3 Kalawati that at 9:00 PM on the next day, the accused
was recognized by the prosecutrix.
17. According to prosecutrix, she was medically
examined on the next day of incident i.e. 09.10.2009, but
in the medical report, it has come that she was examined
on 10.10.2009 by PW5 Dr. Prabha Joshi.
18. There are major contradictions in the statements
of PW1 Laxman Ram, the prosecutrix and PW3 Kalawati.
19. The prosecution has failed to prove its case
against the respondent-accused beyond reasonable doubt.
There is no occasion for us to interfere with the well-reasoned judgment of the trial court.
20. Accordingly, there is no merit in this appeal and
the same is hereby dismissed.

(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) (Rajiv Sharma, J.)
NISHANT
